quarterly_data.signal: At June 30, 2026, Vicor had approximately $22,745,000 of cancelable and non-cancelable capital expenditure commitments, principally for manufacturing and production equipment, to be funded with existing cash. Inventories increased by approximately $9,659,000, or 10.2%, to $104,489,000 at June 30, 2026 from March 31, 2026, in anticipation of increased volume to fulfill backlog.
